ui.Add {n} new TexCom phrases? They go into: Oyongereko ebigambo ebipya {n} ebya TexCom? Bijja kugenda mu kiti “{category}” obirabe. Tewali kigambo kyo kikyusibwa oba kiggyibwawo.
ui.Added {n} phrases to “{category}”. Keep: Ebigambo {n} byongeddwa mu “{category}”. Kuuma by'oyagala; ebirala bisangule mu Kulongoosa.
ui.Can’t reach the conversation service. Tr: Tetusobola kutuuka ku mpeereza y'okwogerezeganya. Tuddamu okugezaako…
ui.Custom Details (e.g. 45-year-old from Lo: Ebikukwatako (okugeza, emyaka 45, ava London, enseko ez'okusekerera)
ui.Describe yourself to the AI. It will use: Nnyonnyola ku ggwe eri AI. Ejja kukikozesa okukola eby'okuddamu eby'otoma n'okuteebereza ebigambo bikutuukirire.
ui.Each language has its own phrases: switc: Buli lulimi lulina ebigambo byalwo: okukyusa olulimi kukuuma byonna. Eddoboozi, okuwuliriza, eby'okuddamu ebiweereddwa n'ebiwandiiko bya TexCom bigoberera olulimi.
ui.Import phrases from a text file…: Yingiza ebigambo okuva mu fayiro y'ebiwandiiko…
ui.It’s in {language}, so TexCom has switch: Kiri mu {language}, n'olwekyo TexCom ekyusizza okudda ku {language}.
ui.On-device AI isn’t available on this dev: AI ey'oku kyuma teriiwo ku kyuma kino.
AI ey'oku kyuma yeetaaga iOS 26 oba macOS 26.
ui.Paste the link you were sent, or type th: Teekamu enkolagana gye bakuweerezza, oba wandiika koodi.
ui.Put back the phrases you were using befo: Okomyewo ebigambo bye wakozesanga edda? Ebyo by'olina kati bikuumibwa, n'olwekyo osobola okudda mu ngeri y'emu.
ui.Read partner's messages aloud: Soma obubaka bwa munno mu ddoboozi
ui.Send this link to the person you want to: Weereza enkolagana eno eri omuntu gw'oyagala okwogera naye, oba muleke asike koodi. Asobola okukozesa essimu oba kompyuta yonna, oba TexCom ye.
ui.Someone using TexCom would like to talk: Omuntu akozesa TexCom ayagala okwogera naawe. Bakuyite batya?
ui.Talk with someone anywhere: send them a: Yogera n'omuntu yenna wonna: muweereze enkolagana (oba laga koodi). Asobola okukozesa essimu oba kompyuta yonna, oba TexCom ye. Ggwe olonda ani ayingira. Mwembi mwetaaga yintaneeti.
ui.TexCom can’t use the microphone. Allow M: TexCom tesobola kukozesa mayikulofoni. Kkiriza Mayikulofoni n'Okutegeera Okwogera eri TexCom mu Nsengeka.
ui.TexCom couldn’t get the {language} phras: TexCom tesobodde kufuna bigambo bya {language}. Byetaaga yintaneeti omulundi ogusooka.
ui.TexCom couldn’t save your phrases (the s: TexCom tesobodde kukuuma bigambo byo (etterekero lijjudde). Enkyukakyuka yo esembayo eyinza okubula TexCom bw'eggalwawo. Kuuma ekibinja ky'ebigambo byo mu fayiro mu Nsengeka > Data.
ui.That conversation isn’t open. Ask for a: Emboozi eyo tegguddwawo. Saba enkolagana empya.
ui.That file isn’t a TexCom phrase set (it: Fayiro eyo si kibinja kya bigambo bya TexCom (tesomeka).
Fayiro eyo si kibinja kya bigambo bya TexCom.
Eyo si nkolagana oba koodi y'emboozi.
Ekyo kiri dda mu Bye Njagala.
ui.The features below run privately on the: Ebintu wansi bikolera mu kyama ku kyuma, n'olwekyo byetaaga app ya TexCom eya iPhone, iPad, Mac oba Android. Tebiriiwo mu browser.
ui.The phrases it replaced are in Settings: Ebigambo bye kyadda mu kifo kyabyo biri mu Nsengeka > Data > Komyawo ebigambo eby'edda.
ui.There isn’t room to keep a copy of your: Tewali kifo kukuuma kkopi y'ebigambo byo ebya kati, n'olwekyo tebiddiziddwa. Sooka obikuume mu fayiro (Ensengeka > Data).
ui.There’s no {language} voice on this devi: Tewali ddoboozi lya {language} ku kyuma kino, n'olwekyo TexCom ejja kusoma n'eddoboozi lye erina. Osobola okwongerako amaloboozi mu nsengeka z'ekyuma (Okutuukirirwa > Ebyogerwa oba Okwogera).
ui.They become your {language} phrases, to: Bino bifuuka ebigambo byo ebya {language}, obikyuse nga bw'oyagala. Ebigambo byo ebya {current} bisigala nga bwe biri: ddayo buli lw'oyagala.
ui.They were translated by machine and have: Bino byavvuunulwa ekyuma era tebinnakeberebwa ayogera {language}.
ui.This conversation isn’t open. Ask for a: Emboozi eno tegguddwawo. Saba enkolagana empya.
ui.This device can’t listen in {language},: Ekyuma kino tekisobola kuwuliriza mu {language}, n'olwekyo mayikulofoni ewuliriza mu lulimi olwasooka.
ui.This link is incomplete. Ask for the lin: Enkolagana eno tewedde. Saba enkolagana nate.
ui.Type or choose a phrase first, then pres: Sooka owandiike oba olonde ekigambo, oluvannyuma nyiga ♡ okukyongera mu Bye Njagala.
ui.You have changed this phrase set. Save i: Okyusizza ekibinja ky'ebigambo kino. Okikuume nga tonnaggulawo kirala?
ui.Your phrases were restored from TexCom’s: Ebigambo byo bikomezeddwawo okuva ku kkopi ya TexCom ey'okwerinda.
ui.Your previous phrases are back. (The one: Ebigambo byo eby'edda bikomyewo. (Bye wakozesanga bikuumiddwa, n'olwekyo osobola okudda mu ngeri y'emu.)
ui.{n} new TexCom phrases are available. Yo: Ebigambo ebipya {n} ebya TexCom biriwo. Osobola okubyongerako mu Nsengeka > Data.

help.help_2: TexCom ekuyamba okwogera ng’owandiika oba ng’olonda ebigambo ebiwedde, era ebyogera mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka.
help.help_3: Okozesa TexCom mu web browser. Buli kimu wano kikola okuggyako ebikozesebwa ebiwandiikiddwako apps only, ebyetaaga app ya TexCom eya iPhone, iPad oba Mac.
help.help_13: Wandiika mu kasanduuko aka kyenvu, olwo onyige Yogera.
help.help_14: Nkwata ku kisoko okukyongera mu kasanduuko, olwo onyige Yogera. Osobola okwongerako ebigambo ebiwerako, oba okuwandiika ebirala ebibyetoolodde.
help.help_15: Ebigambo ebimu biteekebwawo okwogera butereevu ng'obikuba ("Obubaka obw'amangu", laba Okulongoosa).
help.help_16: Ekibokisi ky’ebiwandiiko nakyo kye kinoonya. Nga bw’owandiika, olukalala lulaga ebigambo ebirimu ebigambo okuva ku nkomerero yo esembayo, koma, akabonero k’ekibuuzo (n’ebirala). Koona ku emu n’ekyusa ebigambo ebyo. Okugeza, wandiika Nkooye. caayi n'onyiga "Si kikopo kyange ekya caayi." Layini Ekwatagana eraga ng'olukalala lusengekeddwa; tap its ✕ okuddamu okulaba buli kisoko.
help.help_17: Enfupi: wandiika ekkubo ery'ekisoko n'ogobererwa / ne kifuuka ekisoko kyonna. Okugeza, singa "Hello" eba n'ekkubo erimpi h, okuwandiika h/ kiwa "Hello".
help.help_18: Ekisoko ekirimu [***] kiteeka mu linnya lyo (Ensengeka> Erinnya lyo).
help.help_20: Ku screen enfunda buttons ezimu zigenda mu ⋯ menu ku nkomerero y'ebbaala y'ebikozesebwa.
help.help_26: Wuliriza munno: assaako akazindaalo oba aggyako (emmyufu ng’owuliriza). enkola zokka
help.help_32: SOS: ekuba S-O-S mu koodi ya Morse okuyita okuyambibwa.
help.help_34: Eky'Okwagala: ayongera ebiri mu kasanduuko k'ebiwandiiko ku Bisinga okwagala.
help.help_36: Edit: eggulawo n'okuggyako mode ya Edit (laba Editing).
help.help_42: Ebigambo bikuŋŋaanyiziddwa mu bibinja . Koona ku mutendera olabe ebigambo byakyo; Byonna biraga buli kisoko.
help.help_43: Ku ssimu ekutte nga yeegolodde, kwata ku Categories waggulu w’ebigambo okulonda ekimu.
help.help_44: Ebisinga okwagala bikwata ebigambo by’osinga okukozesa. Okwongerako emu ng’okozesa akabonero ka ♡, oba ssaako akabonero ku Favorites ng’olongoosa ekigambo.
help.help_46: Ku ssirini ennene, ssika ebbaala wakati w’ennyiriri zombi okusobola okufuula emu egazi.
help.help_48: Nywa ku ✎ Edit. Buli kisoko n'omutendera bifuna akabonero ka ✎, era "+ Add phrase" / "+ Add category" birabika waggulu ku nkalala.
help.help_49: Mu mulongoosa osobola okukyusa ebigambo, akabonero (okuwandiika oba okuteeka emoji), ekkubo erimpi, ne biti ki gye kirimu.
help.help_50: Obubaka obw’amangu: ekigambo ekyo kyogera amangu ddala ng’okikuba.
help.help_52: Mu mbeera ya Edit, ssika omukono gwa ⠿ okutuuka ku okuddamu okusengeka ebigambo oba ebika.
help.help_56: Nywa 🎙 era TexCom ewuliriza omuntu gw'oyogera naye. Bye boogera birabika waggulu ku ssirini, era TexCom esobola okuteesa ku by’okuddamu. enkola zokka
help.help_57: Ensengeka> Smart AI> Tandika okuwuliriza nga TexCom egguddewo ekoleeza akazindaalo buli lw’otandika TexCom.
help.help_58: Nga kiiboodi eyungiddwa, omuntu omulala asobola okunyiga ekisumuluzo ` (okumpi ne 1 oba Z), okuwandiika, n'okunyiga Enter. Ebigambo byabwe birabika waggulu ku ssirini. Esc esazaamu.
help.help_59: Ku ssimu oba kompyuta yaabwe, wonna
help.help_60: Ensengeka> Emboozi> Tandika emboozi... ekuwa link ne code ennyimpi. Gabana enkolagana (mu bubaka oba email), oba baleke basikane QR code.
help.help_61: Basobola okukozesa essimu yonna oba kompyuta (bamala kuggulawo link), oba TexCom yaabwe (Weegatte ku mboozi..., olwo ne bateeka link oba okuwandiika code).
help.help_62: Bwe bagezaako okwegatta, TexCom ekusaba: Kiriza oba Gaana. Tewali yeegatta nga tolina ky’oyogera. Buli mboozi erina akakwate akapya.
help.help_63: By’oyogera birabika nga binene nnyo ku screen yaabwe. Bye bawandiika birabika mu ebyafaayo byo eby’emboozi.
help.help_64: Ebbaala eri waggulu wa chat eraga gw’oyogera naye. Nywa End okumaliriza.
help.help_65: Soma obubaka bwa munno mu ddoboozi ery'omwanguka (Ensengeka> Emboozi) eyogera obubaka bwabwe gy'oli.
help.help_68: Ensengeka> Smart AI> Laga ebyafaayo by’emboozi eraga emboozi okutuusa kati, wansi w’ebiti (oba waggulu w’ebigambo ku ssimu ekwatiddwa nga yeegolodde). Bulijjo kiraga nga bali mu mboozi ku yintaneeti.
help.help_69: Senda ebbaala waggulu waayo okugifuula ennene oba entono.
help.help_71: Bino bitambulira mu kyama ku kyuma kyo (Apple Intelligence), kale tewali ky’oyogera kiweerezeddwa wonna. Beetaaga iPhone, iPad oba Mac eyaakafuluma.
help.help_72: Eby’okuddamu ebiteeseddwa: ggwe oba munno bw’omala okwogera, okuddamu okutuuka ku ssatu kulabika waggulu ku lukalala lw’ebigambo, nga kuliko akabonero 🧠. Koona ku emu okugikozesa. Wandiika ^ okusaba amagezi amapya.
help.help_73: Okuteebereza ebigambo ebiddako: nga bw’owandiika, kirabika ebigambo ebiddako birabika nga obutambi. Koona ku emu okugigattako.
help.help_74: Smart Expand: wandiika ekiwandiiko ekimpi okikomekkereze ne @ (okugeza need drink@) era TexCom ekiwandiika nga sentensi enzijuvu. Kikyuse mu Settings> Smart AI.
help.help_75: AI persona (Settings> Smart AI> Edit AI persona...): buulira AI ebikukwatako, gamba nga eddoboozi lyo, nnakyusa, engeri y’okwogera ku kiyamba kyo eky’empuliziganya, n’ebirala byonna by’erina okumanya, kale ebiteeso biwulikika nga ggwe.
help.help_78: Okwogera: londa eddoboozi, eddoboozi, sipiidi n’eddoboozi, era onyige Eddoboozi Gezesa okuliwulira.
help.help_80: Data: yingiza ebigambo okuva mu fayiro y'ebiwandiiko, ggulawo oba otereke ekibiina ky'ebigambo, oba kigabana.
help.help_82: Okulongoosa TexCom tekikyusa oba kuggyawo bigambo byo, ebika oba ensengeka.
help.help_83: Okulongoosa bwe kuleeta ebigambo ebipya, TexCom ekugamba omulundi gumu, era Ensengeka> Data eraga Yongera ebigambo bya TexCom ebipya.... Zigenda mu kiti kya Ebigambo ebipya osobole okutunulamu. Ezo z’oyagala zikuume era ezisigadde ozisazeemu.
help.help_84: Okukuuma kkopi, oba okutambuza ebigambo byo ku kyuma ekirala, kozesa Ensengeka> Data> Teeka ensengeka y’ebigambo... ne Ggulawo ensengeka y’ebigambo....
